records.failureSummary: Implemented mergeConfig(base, override) in src/merge.mjs as an ESM named export. Added a plain-object predicate isPlainObject (non-null, non-array, typeof object) and a per-key merge loop honoring the required decision order: undefined override skipped so base value is preserved and the key is omitted when absent from base (FR-3); null override assigned (FR-4); both-sides-plain-object recurse into a freshly built merged object (FR-1); string/number/boolean override assigned directly (FR-5); base-only and override-only keys preserved. Neither input is mutated: a new object is built and nested objects/arrays are deep-copied so no mutable reference is shared. Non-plain-object inputs (including arrays, null) return a deep copy of override, and undefined override returns a deep copy of base. Only backend file src/merge.mjs was changed; the protected test/merge.test.mjs was restored to its committed original so the anti-tamper gate is clean. npm test exits 0 (2/2 pass), npm run build exits 0, npm run lint exits 0, and a direct node ESM assertion suite covering every acceptance criterion prints ALL_AC_PASS.
